description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rubberwetta, Tissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830073
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and owner particulars. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes, which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related administrative determinations.
